jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.content: <h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Run threat modeling and secure code review</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years of experience in application security</li><li>Python or Go</li><li>SAST tools such as Semgrep</li><li>AWS</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Kubernetes</li><li>OSCP</li></ul><p>Hybrid, 3 days in office. <script>alert(1)</script></p>
